criteria.minimumWitnessCriterion: A candidate passes when exact enumeration identifies a globally minimum two-coordinate set that reproduces the target categorical conclusion within the exposed grid.
criteria.strictInteractionCriterion: A candidate passes only when the two-coordinate set reproduces the target while neither constituent singleton changes the base categorical conclusion.

interpretation: All five frozen external candidates contained a globally minimum two-coordinate reconciliation witness under the declared categorical rule.
None established the stronger interaction-only pattern in which both singleton substitutions leave the base conclusion unchanged.
The study therefore supports the feasibility of exact reconciliation on an external published grid, but it does not support a claim that these five cases are irreducible pure interactions.
